shared_elements: registers/horizontal bands stacked one above another
procession or row of figures facing the same direction
low relief carving of figures with linear detail
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief human figures in profile arranged in stacked horizontal registers, moving in file toward a focal figure, with animals and carried objects among them — a fairly specific shared narrative-procession scheme. However, B additionally carries bands of dense script-like signs and a winged emblem crowning the top, and its figures are squatter and more crowded, whereas A shows tall, evenly spaced standing figures with a tree separating groups and no comparable inscription or winged motif.
